name: the first poll decides at once, in either direction
one poll without an address is a glitch, two in a row are an outage
the line is back at the first good poll
a route read that failed says nothing, so it never takes the line down
two route reads in a row that worked and found no default route take the line down
a failed read between two misses does not reset them, a good read does
a route reading that is too old is ignored
a route reading from the outage does not keep the line down once the address is back
a line with an address but no default route stays down, and does not flap
two polls closer than the minimum gap count once
reset forgets everything, so the next poll decides at once
a miss that is old by the time the next one arrives does not add up with it
route misses from before an address outage do not add up with one new miss afterwards
while lines are tested, a line whose address returns stays down until a test passes
without tests, a line is back at the first poll with an address
a returning line whose tests fail stays down, and three failures make it offline
a returning line is trusted on its address once no test could say anything for a while
one failed test, then tests that can’t run, doesn’t leave a returning line checking forever
a routing restart keeps a returning line waiting for its first passing test
a single poll without an address is a glitch and asks for no test afterwards
the first poll after a reset never waits for a test
a route read that started before the address came back is ignored, whenever it ends
